pass6_context: Pass 6 Unit 2 production-loads the pure journal contract and a read-only view/export adapter, then adds a Diagnostics card backed by an ephemeral empty journal. The owner has no append or restore path; export is manual, redacted, deterministic, and bounded to 256 entries and 262144 bytes.
rule: The root trust anchor cannot verify its own pre-execution bytes; it carries the exact digest for the deterministic protected runtime source set.
